mapper.select: /*selectMasterMpRqSellerChoice3PopHdList*/ SELECT DISTINCT MAX((SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=A.BUYER AND STATUS <> 'D')) AS BUYER_NAME, CASE WHEN MAX(TRIM(A.BTOA_USER_TEL)) IS NULL THEN MAX(A.BTOA_USER_NAME) ELSE MAX(A.BTOA_USER_NAME)||'('|| MAX(A.BTOA_USER_TEL) ||')' END AS BTOA_USER_NAME, MAX(A.BTOA_DATE) AS BTOA_DATE, MAX(SUBSTR(B.ATOS_END_DATE,0,4) ||'/'||SUBSTR(B.ATOS_END_DATE,5,2)||'/'||SUBSTR(B.ATOS_END_DATE,7,2) ||' ' ||SUBSTR(NVL(TRIM(B.ATOS_END_TIME),'19'),0,2)||':'||SUBSTR(NVL(TRIM(B.ATOS_END_TIME),'19'),3,2)) AS ATOS_END_DATE, MAX(CASE WHEN B.ATOS_END_DATE||B.ATOS_END_TIME < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS END_TIME_FLAG, MAX(A.IMAGE_KEY) AS IMAGE_KEY, MAX((SELECT COM_NAME_LOC||RATE FROM ICOMCMPY A , (SELECT BUYER,'['||YYYYMM||': '||BUYER_RATE||'%]' AS RATE FROM MIS_MNG_RATE WHERE BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND ROWNUM = 1 ORDER BY YYYYMM DESC) B WHERE A.COM_CODE = #{st_buyer} AND A.COM_CODE = B.BUYER(+))) AS BUYER_NAME2, CASE WHEN #{st_sour_dept_yn} = 'Y' THEN (SELECT NVL(TO_NUMBER(MAX(TEXT1)),'') FROM ICOMCOD3 COD WHERE COD.BUYER ='KRKORE0001' AND COD.TYPE ='CMSG' AND COD.CODE1 = A.BUYER AND COD.CODE2 = A.SG_ID) ELSE MAX((SELECT NVL(RATE,0) FROM KEP_BUYER_RATE WHERE BUYER=A.BUYER AND TO_DATE='299912' AND CONTRACT_FLAG='F')) END AS MARGIN_RATE, MAX((SELECT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=A.BUYER AND STATUS IN ('C','R'))) AS CATLG_CODE, MAX(NVL(A.IMPORT_FLAG,'N')) AS IMPORT_FLAG, CASE WHEN #{st_sour_dept_yn} = 'Y' THEN DECODE(MAX(A.SG_ID),'SG118', '0', 'SG153', '0', 'SG163', '0', NVL(MAX(A.PROCESS_TYPE), (SELECT CMPY.PROCESS_TYPE FROM ICOMCMPY CMPY WHERE CMPY.COM_CODE = A.BUYER))) ELSE NVL(A.PROCESS_TYPE, 0) END AS PROCESS_TYPE, CASE WHEN #{st_sour_dept_yn} = 'Y' THEN DECODE(MAX(A.SG_ID),'SG118', '직납', 'SG153', '직납', 'SG163', '직납', NVL((SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE='M034' AND CODE=A.PROCESS_TYPE), (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE='M034' AND CODE=(SELECT CMPY.PROCESS_TYPE FROM ICOMCMPY CMPY WHERE CMPY.COM_CODE = A.BUYER)))) ELSE (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE='M034' AND CODE=A.PROCESS_TYPE) END AS PROCESS_NAME, CASE WHEN #{st_sour_dept_yn} = 'Y' THEN DECODE(MAX(A.SG_ID),'SG118', '', 'SG153', '', 'SG163', '', NVL(MAX(A.WAREHOUSE_CODE),(SELECT CMPY.WAREHOUSE_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY CMPY WHERE CMPY.COM_CODE = A.BUYER))) ELSE MAX(A.WAREHOUSE_CODE) END AS WAREHOUSE_CODE, MAX(NVL(A.BELOW_COMORG_CODE,DECODE(NVL(FLAG.BELOW_COMORG_ALL_FLAG,'N'),'N',A.BUYER,'ALL'))) AS BELOW_COMORG_CODE, MAX(DECODE(A.BELOW_COMORG_CODE, 'ALL','전체', NVL((SELECT COMORG_NAME FROM BYCAORGL WHERE COMORG_CODE=A.BELOW_COMORG_CODE) ,DECODE(NVL(FLAG.BELOW_COMORG_ALL_FLAG,'N'),'Y', '전체', (SELECT CMPY.COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY CMPY WHERE CMPY.COM_CODE = NVL(A.BELOW_COMORG_CODE,A.BUYER)))))) AS BELOW_COMORG_NAME, MAX((SELECT NVL(RATE,0) FROM KEP_BUYER_RATE WHERE BUYER=A.BUYER AND TO_DATE='299912' AND CONTRACT_FLAG='N')) AS BUYER_RATE, MAX(A.LOGISTICS_FEE) AS LOGISTICS_FEE, MAX(CMS.CMS_CATLG_ID) CMS_CATLG_ID, MAX(CMS.CMS_CATEG_ID) CMS_CATEG_ID, MAX(A.BUYER) AS BUYER , MAX(A.MAKER_NAME) AS MAKER_NAME, MAX(A.MAKER_CODE) AS MAKER_CODE, MAX((SELECT SG_ID FROM CMSCATEG WHERE CMS_CATEG_ID = A.CMS_CATEG_ID)) AS SG_ID, MAX((SELECT SG_NAME FROM KEPSGMG WHERE SG_ID = (SELECT SG_ID FROM CMSCATEG WHERE CMS_CATEG_ID = A.CMS_CATEG_ID))) AS SG_NAME, MAX((SELECT AG_ID FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.BUYER)) AS AG_ID, MAX((SELECT MAX(SIDO) FROM ICOMZIPC WHERE AG_ID = (SELECT AG_ID FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.BUYER))) AS AG_SI, CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') <= MAX(B.ATOS_END_DATE||B.ATOS_END_TIME) AND MAX(ADMIN_CLOSE_FLAG) = 'N' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS ADMIN_CLOSE_FLAG, MAX(ADMIN_CLOSE_FLAG) AS ADMIN_CLOSE_FLAG_2, MAX(A.PRE_GR_FLAG) AS PRE_GR_FLAG, MAX(NVL(RATE.RATE_EDIT_FLAG, 'Y')) AS BUYER_RATE_EDIT, MAX(NVL(RATE.RATE_GUBUN, 'S')) AS BUYER_RATE_GUBUN , MAX(NVL(RATE.CONTRACT_FLAG,'N')) AS CONTRACT_FLAG , MAX(A.SAFETY_FLAG) AS SAFETY_FLAG , MAX((SELECT DECODE(COUNT(B.SLG_ID),0,'N','Y') FROM BNTSLGDEF C , BNTSLGIMP B WHERE C.SLG_ID = B.SLG_ID AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN C.OPEN_DATE AND C.CLOSE_DATE AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN B.OPEN_DATE AND B.CLOSE_DATE AND B.COM_CODE = #{st_buyer} AND C.SLG_ID = 'P04-4041-06')) AS EARLY_END_FLAG , MAX((SELECT DECODE(COUNT(*), 0, 'Y', 'N') FROM KEP_AFTER_ITEM_MD_REQ WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND QUOTATION_NO = A.QUOTATION_NO AND QUOTATION_SEQ = A.QUOTATION_SEQ AND REVISION = A.REVISION AND ITEM_MD_STATUS = 'C' AND ITEM_MD_USER_ID IS NULL)) AS AFTER_ITEM_MD_COMPLETE FROM KEPRQDT A, KEPQTDT B , CMSCATLG CMS, KEP_BUYER_RATE RATE, KEP_BUYER_FLAG FLAG WHERE A.BUYER=#{st_buyer} AND A.QUOTATION_NO=#{st_quotation_no} AND A.QUOTATION_SEQ=#{st_quotation_seq} AND A.REVISION=#{st_revision} AND B.BUYER=A.BUYER AND B.QUOTATION_NO=A.QUOTATION_NO AND B.QUOTATION_SEQ=A.QUOTATION_SEQ AND B.REVISION=A.REVISION AND B.STATUS <> 'O' AND A.RECV_FLAG <> 'GD' AND A.STATUS <> 'D' AND A.CMS_CATLG_ID = CMS.CMS_CATLG_ID(+) AND CMS.STD_FLAG(+) = 'Y' AND A.BUYER=RATE.BUYER(+) AND A.BUYER=FLAG.COM_CODE(+) AND RATE.FROM_DATE(+) <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AND RATE.TO_DATE(+) >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') GROUP BY A.BUYER, A.QUOTATION_NO, A.QUOTATION_SEQ, A.REVISION, A.SG_ID, A.PROCESS_TYPE

/*selectMasterMpRqSellerChoice3PopReNoteList*/ SELECT MNG.BUYER, MNG.QUOTATION_NO, MNG.QUOTATION_SEQ, MNG.REVISION, MNG.ADD_USER_ID, (SELECT USR.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID = MNG.ADD_USER_ID) AS ADD_USER_NM, TO_CHAR(MNG.ADD_DATE,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI') AS ADD_DATE, MNG.ADD_NOTE, (SELECT USR.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID = MNG.CHANGE_USER_ID) AS CHANGE_USER_NM, TO_CHAR(MNG.CHANGE_DATE,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI') AS CHANGE_DATE, MNG.SEQ, MNG.IMAGE_KEY, DECODE(MNG.IMAGE_KEY,'',2,3) AS IMAGE_KEY_IMG FROM KEP_RQDT_NOTE_MNG MNG WHERE 1=1 AND MNG.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND MNG.QUOTATION_NO = #{st_quotation_no} AND MNG.QUOTATION_SEQ = #{st_quotation_seq} AND MNG.REVISION = #{st_revision} AND MNG.STATUS != 'D' ORDER BY MNG.ADD_DATE DESC

Y.REVISION = X.REVISION AND Y.STATUS != 'D' AND NVL(Y.STOA_LIST_PRICE,0) = NVL(X.T_MIN_PRICE,0)) AS T_ROUND FROM ( SELECT DECODE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KEPQTDT WHERE BUYER=A.BUYER AND QUOTATION_NO=A.QUOTATION_NO AND QUOTATION_SEQ=A.QUOTATION_SEQ AND REVISION=A.REVISION AND AGENT=B.AGENT AND STATUS <> 'D'), 1, '신규견적', '재견적요청') AS SOURCING_STATUS, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=B.AGENT AND STATUS <> 'D')||C.RATE AS AGENT_NAME, CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') <= B.ATOS_END_DATE||B.ATOS_END_TIME AND ADMIN_CLOSE_FLAG = 'N' THEN '***' ELSE TO_CHAR(NVL(B.STOA_LIST_PRICE,0)) END AS STOA_LIST_PRICE, CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') <= B.ATOS_END_DATE||B.ATOS_END_TIME AND ADMIN_CLOSE_FLAG = 'N' THEN '***' ELSE TO_CHAR(DECODE(NVL(B.STOA_LIST_PRICE, 0), 0, '미제출', DECODE(ROUND((NVL(B.STOA_LIST_PRICE, 0) / (SELECT MIN(STOA_LIST_PRICE) FROM KEPQTDT WHERE BUYER = B.BUYER AND QUOTATION_NO = B.QUOTATION_NO AND QUOTATION_SEQ = B.QUOTATION_SEQ AND REVISION = B.REVISION AND AGENT_REVISION = B.AGENT_REVISION AND STATUS = 'C' AND STOA_LIST_PRICE <> 0) * 100) - 100, 1), 0, '최저가', ROUND((NVL(B.STOA_LIST_PRICE, 0) AND STATUS = 'C' AND STOA_LIST_PRICE <> 0) * 100) - 100, 1)))) END AS BETWEEN_RATE, B.STOA_REMARK, DECODE(B.STOA_REMARK,'','0','1') AS STOA_REMARK_IMG, B.BUYER, B.QUOTATION_NO, B.QUOTATION_SEQ, B.REVISION, B.AGENT, B.AGENT_REVISION, B.LEAD_TIME, A.ATOS_REMARK, NVL(B.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE, 0) AS ATOB_UNIT_PRICE, CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') <= B.ATOS_END_DATE||B.ATOS_END_TIME AND ADMIN_CLOSE_FLAG = 'N' THEN '***' ELSE TO_CHAR(DECODE(A.BUYER, 'KRPOON0010', DECODE(NVL(B.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE,0), 0, '', ROUND(((B.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE - B.STOA_LIST_PRICE)/DECODE(B.STOA_LIST_PRICE,0,1,B.STOA_LIST_PRICE))*100,1)), 'KRDOOS0015', DECODE(NVL(B.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE,0), 0, '', ROUND(((B.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE - B.STOA_LIST_PRICE)/DECODE(B.STOA_LIST_PRICE,0,1,B.STOA_LIST_PRICE))*100,1)), 'KRDOOD0001', DECODE(NVL(B.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE,0), 0, '', ROUND(((B.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE - B.STOA_LIST_PRICE)/DECODE(B.STOA_LIST_PRICE,0,1,B.STOA_LIST_PRICE))*100,1)), DECODE(NVL(B.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE,0), 0, '', ROUND(((B.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE - B.STOA_LIST_PRICE)/DECODE(B.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE,0,1,B.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE))*100,1)) )) END AS RATE , B.MAKER_NAME, B.ORIGIN_NAME AS ORIGIN_CODE, (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE='M001' and code=B.ORIGIN_NAME) AS ORIGIN_NAME, B.SELLER_IMAGE_KEY, DECODE(B.SELLER_IMAGE_KEY,'','2','3') AS SELLER_IMAGE_KEY_IMG, NVL(A.BUYER_TARGET_PRICE, 0) AS BUYER_TARGET_PRICE, DECODE(A.BUYER,'KRDHIM0001', /*두산인프라용*/ (CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') <= B.ATOS_END_DATE||B.ATOS_END_TIME AND ADMIN_CLOSE_FLAG = 'N' THEN '***' ELSE TO_CHAR((SELECT CASE WHEN (SUM(GRDT.ITEM_AMT)=0 OR SUM(GRDT.AGENT_ITEM_AMT)=0) THEN DECODE(ROUND(DECODE(SUM(CQDT.UNIT_PRICE)-SUM(CQDT.LIST_PRICE),0,0,(SUM(CQDT.UNIT_PRICE)-SUM(CQDT.LIST_PRICE))/SUM(CQDT.UNIT_PRICE),3))*100,0,'신규',NULL, '신규',ROUND((SUM(CQDT.UNIT_PRICE)-SUM(CQDT.LIST_PRICE))/SUM(CQDT.UNIT_PRICE),3)*100) ELSE DECODE(ROUND(DECODE(SUM(GRDT.ITEM_AMT)-SUM(GRDT.AGENT_ITEM_AMT),0,0,(SUM(GRDT.ITEM_AMT)-SUM(GRDT.AGENT_ITEM_AMT))/SUM(GRDT.ITEM_AMT),3))*100,0,'신규',NULL,'신규',ROUND((SUM(GRDT.ITEM_AMT)-SUM(GRDT.AGENT_ITEM_AMT))/SUM(GRDT.ITEM_AMT),3)*100) END AS AVG_RATE FROM ICOMGRDT GRDT , ICOMCQDT CQDT WHERE GRDT.BUYER=B.BUYER AND CQDT.BUYER = GRDT.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AND GRDT.AGENT=B.AGENT AND CQDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO = GRDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND GRDT.GR_DATE >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-180, 'YYYYMMDD') AND GRDT.STATUS<>'D')) END) , /*두산인프라외*/ (CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') <= B.ATOS_END_DATE||B.ATOS_END_TIME AND ADMIN_CLOSE_FLAG = 'N' THEN '***' ELSE (SELECT CASE WHEN NVL(SUM(GRDT.ITEM_AMT),0) = 0 OR NVL(SUM(GRDT.AGENT_ITEM_AMT),0) = 0 THEN CASE WHEN NVL(SUM(CQDT.UNIT_PRICE),0) = 0 THEN '신규' ELSE TO_CHAR(ROUND((SUM(CQDT.UNIT_PRICE)-NVL(SUM(CQDT.LIST_PRICE),0))/SUM(CQDT.UNIT_PRICE),3)*100) END ELSE CASE WHEN NVL(SUM(GRDT.ITEM_AMT),0) = 0 THEN '신규' ELSE TO_CHAR(ROUND((SUM(GRDT.ITEM_AMT) - NVL(SUM(GRDT.AGENT_ITEM_AMT),0))/SUM(GRDT.ITEM_AMT),3)*100) END END FROM ICOMGRDT GRDT INNER JOIN ICOMCQDT CQDT ON (1 = 1 AND CQDT.BUYER = GRDT.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AND CQDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO = GRDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO ) WHERE GRDT.BUYER = B.BUYER AND GRDT.AGENT = B.AGENT AND GRDT.GR_DATE >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-180, 'YYYYMMDD') AND GRDT.STATUS IN ('C','R')) END) ) AS AVG_RATE, A.MAKER_CODE , NVL((SELECT MIN(STOA_LIST_PRICE) FROM KEPQTDT WHERE BUYER = B.BUYER AND QUOTATION_NO = B.QUOTATION_NO AND QUOTATION_SEQ = B.QUOTATION_SEQ AND REVISION = B.REVISION AND STATUS ='C' AND NVL(STOA_LIST_PRICE,0) <> 0),0) AS MIN_PRICE , NVL((SELECT MIN(STOA_LIST_PRICE) FROM KEPQTDT WHERE BUYER = B.BUYER AND QUOTATION_NO = B.QUOTATION_NO AND QUOTATION_SEQ = B.QUOTATION_SEQ AND REVISION = B.REVISION AND STATUS != 'D' AND NVL(STOA_LIST_PRICE,0) <> 0),0) AS T_MIN_PRICE , B.BUYER_ITEM_NO , B.DESCRIPTION , B.SPECIFICATION , B.UNIT_MEASURE , B.ITEM_QTY , CASE WHEN B.ATOS_END_DATE||B.ATOS_END_TIME < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS END_TIME_FLAG , RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY B.BUYER, B.QUOTATION_NO, B.QUOTATION_SEQ, B.REVISION ORDER BY B.BUYER, B.QUOTATION_NO, B.QUOTATION_SEQ, B.REVISION , DECODE(NVL(B.STOA_LIST_PRICE,0), 0, 999999999999,B.STOA_LIST_PRICE) ASC, TO_NUMBER(B.LEAD_TIME), B.STOA_DATE, B.STOA_TIME) AS RANK ,F_GET_RE_SGMNG(A.BUYER, A.CMS_CATEG_ID,#{USER_ID},1) AS SG_KEP_YN ,F_GET_RE_SGMNG(A.BUYER, A.CMS_CATEG_ID,#{USER_ID},2) AS SG_GBN , B.MIN_ORDER_QTY , B.PUR_UNIT_QTY , B.SELLER_AREA , DECODE(B.SELLER_AREA,'','4','5') AS SELLER_AREA_IMG , B.PROCESS_TYPE , (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 COD WHERE COD.TYPE = 'M034' AND COD.FLAG = 'Y' AND COD.CODE = B.PROCESS_TYPE) AS PROCESS_NM , B.IMGFILE_DIR AS QTDT_IMGFILE_DIR , B.IMGFILE_NAME AS QTDT_IMGFILE_NAME , DECODE(B.IMGFILE_NAME,'','2','3') AS QTDT_IMGFILE_NAME_IMG , B.TAX_TYPE AS QTDT_TAX_TYPE , DECODE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KEPQTDT QTDT WHERE QTDT.BUYER = B.BUYER AND QTDT.QUOTATION_NO = B.QUOTATION_NO AND QTDT.QUOTATION_SEQ = B.QUOTATION_SEQ AND QTDT.REVISION = B.REVISION AND QTDT.AGENT_REVISION = B.AGENT_REVISION AND QTDT.STATUS = 'C' AND NVL(QTDT.STOA_LIST_PRICE,0) > 0 AND QTDT.STOA_DATE IS NOT NULL ), 1, 'Y', 0, 'Y', 'N') AS SOL_AGENT_YN , B.BID_SUCCESS_REASON , A.PLANT ,NVL2(TRIM(B.IMGFILE_DIR||B.IMGFILE_NAME), 'https://keps3.koreab2b.com/'||B.IMGFILE_DIR|| '/' ||B.IMGFILE_NAME, '') AS QTDT_IMG , B.ITEM_MAKE_TYPE AS AGENT_ITEM_MAKE_TYPE , B.PRE_GR_FLAG AS QTDT_PRE_GR_FLAG , NVL(B.VAT_YN, 'N') AS VAT_YN , A.BTOA_REMARK , A.ATOB_REMARK FROM KEPRQDT A, KEPQTDT B,(SELECT ROWNUM AS NO, AGENT,'['||YYYYMM||': '||BUYER_RATE||'%]' AS RATE FROM MIS_MNG_RATE WHERE BUYER = #{st_buyer} ORDER BY YYYYMM DESC) C WHERE A.BUYER=#{st_buyer} AND A.QUOTATION_NO=#{st_quotation_no} AND A.QUOTATION_SEQ=#{st_quotation_seq} AND A.REVISION=#{st_revision} AND B.BUYER=A.BUYER AND B.QUOTATION_NO=A.QUOTATION_NO AND B.QUOTATION_SEQ=A.QUOTATION_SEQ AND B.REVISION=A.REVISION /*AND B.LEAD_TIME IS NOT NULL*/ AND B.SEL_USER_ID IS NOT NULL AND B.STOA_LIST_PRICE IS NOT NULL AND B.STOA_DATE IS NOT NULL AND B.STOA_TIME IS ASC ) X

/*selectProcessImportRate*/ SELECT DECODE(#{st_process_type},0, NVL(SUPPLY_DIRECT_RATE,0), 1, NVL(STOCK_RATE,0),2,NVL(TR_RATE,0),3,NVL(VMI_RATE,0)) + DECODE(#{st_import_flag},'Y', NVL(IMPORT_RATE,0), 'N', 0) AS PROCESS_IMPORT_RATE FROM TBL_PROCESSTYPE_PRIMECOST_MNG WHERE STATUS='C' AND PROCESSTYPE_STATUS='Y'
